allow.bun.lock: Bun's lockfile for the repo's own dependency graph; `bun test` and the scanner-under-test install flow resolve from it, and Bun writes it only at the package root.
allow.bunfig.toml: Bun requires its config at the package root; wires `[install.security] scanner = "./src/index.ts"` so bun install exercises the scanner under test, per README setup.
